title: Preserve supported score bracket, track-name and display policies
scope: Preserve the three evidenced BinaryStylesheet policy groups: brackets/system separators, track names, and global dynamics/tuning/chord display.
acceptance: Cover System/bracketExtendMode enum variants and Global/useSystemSignSeparator independently with pinned brackets-braces and system-divider fixtures.

Cover single/multi track-name visibility policy, first/other-system full/short names, and horizontal/vertical names. Preserve source key precedence and independently assert the resulting consumer policies.
Cover StandardNotation/hideDynamics, Global/DisplayTuning, Global/DrawChords and System/drawChordInScore with true, false and absence cases and the pinned hide/show fixtures.

For all supported keys, retain exact types and values, validate authored enum boundaries and malformed input, support public edits, and preserve other supported stylesheet settings through the shared codec.
exclusions: hideEmptyStaves, hideEmptyStavesInFirstSystem and showSingleStaffBrackets lack pinned GP mappings and are excluded.
Header/footer templates are #114; barlines/numbering are #109. Part flags, multirests and beam overrides keep their existing owners.

reproduction.instructions: Cover System/bracketExtendMode enum variants and Global/useSystemSignSeparator independently with pinned brackets-braces and system-divider fixtures. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
implementation-ready: Each listed group has explicit pinned BinaryStylesheet mappings and non-default GP8 fixtures. Scope is limited to those groups, with shared codec work supplied by #109.
